name: helm-tasks
description: Send tasks to your configured computers and inspect delivery reports.

scripts.check: node --check extension.js && node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/model.js && node --check lib/webview.js

commands.title: Command Helm: New Task in Current Project

commandHelm.tasks.bridgeUrl.description: Private HTTPS bridge URL. Uses the local bridge certificate and pairing stored by companion setup.

commandHelm.tasks.openOnStartup.description: Open the Command Helm Tasks view when this editor window starts. Enable in a dedicated Tasks workspace.

commandHelm.tasks.localDeviceId.description: Device ID for this computer, from your bridge configuration. Leave blank to disable local folder/report opening. Restart the editor after changing it.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Paired-computer task viewing and manual submission are available. Current-project folder prefilling is disabled until this workspace is trusted.
